disease.description: An autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by global developmental delay, hypotonia, and seizures. Other features include peripheral spasticity with hyperreflexia, variable dysmorphic features, impaired intellectual development, behavioral abnormalities, and hypoplasia or absence of the corpus callosum on brain imaging.
